subject.title: feat(android): add inline dictation to chat composer

question: Should Android adopt inline dictation and the unified one-row composer as the default interaction model, replacing the separate dictation control?
rationale: This is a user-facing feature and control-layout decision rather than a repair to an established behavior contract; the supplied evidence does not establish prior maintainer sponsorship.

options.title: Sponsor after final APK proof
options.body: Confirm the unified composer direction, then require redacted exact-head dictation proof covering active-chat transcript placement before merge.

options.title: Narrow or defer the UI change
options.body: Keep the current composer interaction and pursue dictation or layout changes later with an Android-owned product proposal.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after final APK proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the unified composer direction, then require redacted exact-head dictation proof covering active-chat transcript placement before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline identifies Solvely-Colin as the assigned participant and as an author of the implementation commits.
